value.rationale: The initiating sharp matrix inequality lacks an explicit classification of where equality occurs. The general full-fiber identity establishes interior saturation for arbitrary finite covers, while the complete degree-two iff identifies which pairs fail strictly, resolving a natural, non-arbitrary equality-geometry problem. It is not a mere new numerical example or a restatement of the already-published power-map case; it suggests concrete critical-fiber and higher-degree equality problems.
